resources.string: Deleted items stay in the local library on this device until Rust confirms restore or permanent deletion. No account or A2D server is required.
Rust trash APIs must own deletion state, restore, permanent delete, asset retention, audit events, and ID retirement. This screen does not invent deleted rows or perform destructive work in Kotlin.
Trash rows are supplied by injected presentation state; destructive actions remain callback-only until Rust APIs are connected.
Restore keeps the original identity. Permanent delete must retire identities so page, scan, Notebook, Page Set, and collection IDs are never reused.
Items moved to trash will appear here after the Rust trash lifecycle API exists. Empty state does not invent deleted rows.
